description: This file defines a static utility class 'ManageNavPages' used for managing navigation page identifiers and CSS classes based on the active page within a web application's manage area. It provides constants for page identifiers, methods to determine the navigation class, and helper methods to set the active page context.

methods.name: IndexNavClass
methods.description: Returns the CSS class 'active' if the current view context's active page matches 'Index', otherwise empty.

methods.name: ChangePasswordNavClass
methods.description: Returns the CSS class 'active' if the current view context's active page matches 'ChangePassword', otherwise empty.

methods.name: ExternalLoginsNavClass
methods.description: Returns the CSS class 'active' if the current view context's active page matches 'ExternalLogins', otherwise empty.

methods.name: TwoFactorAuthenticationNavClass
methods.description: Returns the CSS class 'active' if the current view context's active page matches 'TwoFactorAuthentication', otherwise empty.

methods.name: PageNavClass
methods.description: Determines if the given page is active based on the view context and returns 'active' or an empty string accordingly.

methods.name: AddActivePage
methods.description: Sets the active page in the view data dictionary.
